comparison.objective: Fit a spring tension rod level between cupboard walls at a marked height so it supports itself.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress and align a telescoping sprung rod while establishing frictional contact at both ends.
comparison.success_condition: The released rod must press both walls, remain still and clear of the table, meet height/level/square limits, and hold full conditions for four seconds.
comparison.reason: Spring compression and frictional placement between walls do not test tool-mediated stop calibration, jam-nut countertorque, or functional cycling.
